name: Nifty 100 point-in-time research universe
membership_source: NSE Indices Nifty 100 historical constituent/reconstitution records
membership_rule: A symbol is eligible only between its recorded effective_from and effective_to dates.
survivorship_bias_policy: Current constituents must not be applied to the full historical sample.
liquidity_policy: Eligibility requires sufficient 5-minute coverage, plausible prices/volume, adequate recent activity, and valid broker mapping. Exact thresholds must be frozen before final backtest.
next_action: Acquire and commit the point-in-time membership table before selecting any Strategy 002 winner.
